title: Moose Mountain Adventure Golf in Mall of America
blurb:
The course features an original, whimsical design with an old-time Northwoods feel, complete with life-size moose, horses, and more!
Also contains fun cartoon vehicles, including a logging truck, steam locomotive, and biplane. Not only will this custom-crafted course be magical for all who play, it is also designed to be fully accessible, so everyone can enjoy the adventure!
